title: Douyin Collaborates with Volcano Engine to Develop AI-Native Assistant, SAIC Models to Be Launched Within the Year

content_html:
On September 17, Doubao and Volcano Engine jointly developed an AI-native in-vehicle assistant - "Doubao Cabin Assistant" was officially launched, marking the further deep integration of large model technology in the smart car cabin scenario. Currently, the product has reached a deep cooperation with SAIC Group, and its first model equipped with the product, the Roewe Jia Yue 07, is now available for pre-sale, while SAIC Audi-related models will also be officially launched within the year.

In addition, the two sides plan to launch more vehicle models with new features throughout the year. As an AI-native application designed for the smart mobility scenario, the Doubao Cabin Assistant relies on the core capabilities of the Doubao large model and the high-performance cloud infrastructure of Volcano Engine, aiming to reshape the in-vehicle human-machine interaction and intelligent service experience through more natural voice interaction, in-depth context understanding, and multi-scenario collaboration capabilities. As the competition in automotive intelligence gradually shifts from "hardware stacking" to "the soft power of large models," the deep integration of large models and in-vehicle systems has become an industry inevitability.
